_doc: AGENT-DIRECTORIES-1: registries and directories where agents find tools, each with its submission route, what it needs and the packet for Ultrastable's /mcp endpoint. Consumed by scripts/agent_directories.py (called from scripts/outreach.py run), which writes one packet per directory under outreach/packets/agent-directories/ and sets status. Publishing is outreach egress: nothing is sent while outreach/gate.json is dry-run or kill is set, and form or pull-request routes are never submitted by an agent. route_verified stays null until the script's probe has fetched the directory's page.

packet.name: Ultrastable
packet.description: Read-only view of a self-governing development platform: what it is working on, what is next, what is blocked and what it shipped, plus one authenticated tool to submit work.
packet.auth: none for reads; OAuth 2.1 with PKCE for the one write tool
